name: handbook-reader
author: Ahmed Elshazly
description: A local, desktop-class reader for the DealerIQ architecture handbook in docs/.

scripts.dev: npm run fonts --silent && npm run index && vite
scripts.start: npm run fonts --silent && npm run index && concurrently -k -s first -n vite,window "vite" "tsx scripts/open-app-window.ts"
scripts.build: npm run fonts --silent && npm run index && vite build
scripts.pack: npm run fonts --silent && npm run index && PACK=1 vite build && mv dist/index.html dist/handbook.html && echo "\npacked → docs-app/dist/handbook.html"
scripts.site: npm run fonts --silent && npm run index && SITE=1 vite build && echo "\npublished → apps/web/public/handbook/"
